agents.name: Analyst
agents.role: Writes Lightning SQL, runs it through Zetaris, and loads facts with provenance into the World Model

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Builds shelter openings, supply staging and evacuation priority, citing World Model evidence ids

agents.name: Simulator
agents.role: Deterministic capacity, coverage, distance and budget checks; returns structured violations

agents.name: Critic
agents.role: Verifies every claim against cited evidence, flags stale facts, and can reject the plan

agents.name: Risk
agents.role: Classifies actions reversible or irreversible and routes low-confidence or irreversible calls to a human

agents.name: BeliefReviser
agents.role: Diffs the World Model on new events, invalidates only dependent decisions, triggers a targeted replan
